name: Ready-Made Oxygen Integration
author: Levels Branding and Development

sections.description:
Ready-Made Oxygen Integration is an essential plugin for designers using the Ready-Made Figma plugin with Oxygen 4. This lightweight plugin adds the necessary JavaScript code to your WordPress site to enable the copy-paste functionality between Figma designs and Oxygen 4.

Features:

  • Enables seamless copy-paste from Figma to Oxygen 4
  • Paste figma content in oxygen structure view via custom button in the oxygen editor.
  • Works with the Ready-Made Figma plugin
  • Clean, commented code following WordPress standards
  • Minimal impact on site performance
  • No configuration needed – install and it works
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-ready-made folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using the Ready-Made Figma plugin to copy designs to Oxygen 4
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything after installation?

No, the plugin works automatically after activation. No configuration is needed.

What is Ready-Made?

Ready-Made is a Figma plugin that allows designers to select and copy sections from a Figma design and paste them directly into Oxygen 4. This WordPress plugin provides the necessary integration for that functionality to work.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, the plugin is very lightweight and only adds a small script to your site’s footer.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with most caching plugins, but you may need to clear your cache after installation.
